scope: Cross-domain candidate review and chemistry candidate exclusions. This is not a claim of experimentally validating the catalog or proving all pairs semantically disjoint.
candidate_retrieval: At 1722 cards, local character-trigram Jaccard comparison of principle fields returned 22 pairs at threshold 0.14. Scores only retrieve candidates; no score triggers a merge.
